scientific_question: Does any five-of-nine camera subset have enough frozen H1 reconstruction capacity to satisfy the controlled virtual-BOST gates, and can one such subset be shared by every model and time for each reported calibration?
role: post-open truth-aware finite-roster capacity diagnostic; not a deployment selector, not training, not a real experiment, and not a resource result
physical_hypothesis: v169 may have failed because its low-frequency geometry score chose the wrong five cameras. Exhausting all 126 five-camera subsets separates objective mismatch from missing five-view capacity under the unchanged H1 reconstruction shell.

mechanism_boundary.distinct_from_v169: v169 evaluated one geometry-selected subset per calibration; v170 changes no reconstruction method and exhausts the finite five-of-nine subset roster only to diagnose capacity
mechanism_boundary.truth_use: truth may classify finite candidate reconstructions and solve the two offline feasibility problems; it is forbidden from any deployable input or claim
mechanism_boundary.no_post_result_objective: capacity is exact feasibility under the frozen metric gates, not a tunable scalar score
mechanism_boundary.not_training: zero trainable parameters, no predictor, no fitted fallback, and no sensor-policy claim

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is density; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and observations are generated by code; no true experimental pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior inherited unchanged from v169

inputs.models: same nine CPU TorchScript models sealed by v157-v169
inputs.calibrations: same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v169

camera_roster.canonical_order: ascending exact finite float tuple; geometry keys must be unique
camera_roster.candidate_roster: all lexicographically ordered combinations of five canonical cameras from nine
camera_roster.permutation_contract: reordering input camera records preserves canonical candidates and every physical reconstruction

reconstruction.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
reconstruction.forbidden_variants: no alternate basis, H1 order, multiplier, camera cardinality, field normalization, metric threshold, selector score, fallback, or learned model

cellwise_upper_bound.definition: one truth-aware subset may be chosen independently for every model-calibration-time cell
cellwise_upper_bound.interpretation: a necessary upper bound for every hard five-camera selector; infeasibility closes the finite hard-subset family under frozen H1

calibration_shared.definition: one truth-aware subset is shared by all nine models and four times belonging to each calibration
calibration_shared.interpretation: matches the dependency class of a geometry-only selector; feasibility indicates objective-design headroom only

capacity_levels.feasibility_solver: formal uses exact binary MILP constraints; independent validation uses dominance-pruned integer dynamic programming
capacity_levels.witness_policy: any witness satisfying every frozen constraint is valid; witness identity is not a scientific outcome and is not required to be unique

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time for each capacity level

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration, shared by all 126 subsets, models, and times
cost_accounting.candidate_search: offline truth-aware dense algebra over 126 subsets; forbidden as a deployment-cost claim
cost_accounting.single_chosen_h1_online_after_geometry_c: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent and one exact reduced A equivalent
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden; no fresh-process wall or whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy idctn construction
independent_recomputation.solver: scipy symmetric eigensolve rather than numpy eigensolve
independent_recomputation.capacity: dominance-pruned integer dynamic programming rather than formal MILP

decision_order: Any input, operator, basis, solver, metric-classification, feasibility, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v170 inconclusive.
If the cellwise truth-aware upper bound is infeasible, conclude FAIL_NO_FIVE_CAMERA_H1_SUBSET_CAPACITY_V170 and close every hard five-of-nine subset selector under frozen H1 on this opened roster.

If cellwise capacity is feasible but calibration-shared capacity is infeasible, conclude FAIL_NO_GEOMETRY_ONLY_SHARED_FIVE_CAMERA_SUBSET_CAPACITY_V170 and close geometry-only shared hard-subset selection while retaining only the diagnostic possibility of observation-adaptive selection.
Only if calibration-shared capacity is feasible and its witness passes all four frozen strata may v170 conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_ONLY_SHARED_FIVE_CAMERA_SUBSET_CAPACITY_V170.
A pass establishes only post-open controlled virtual-proxy capacity headroom and does not authorize a predictor, GPU, resource claim, external claim, or real-BOST claim.
